title: DSSE envelope
description: Dead Simple Signing Envelope (https://github.com/secure-systems-lab/dsse). Field names follow the DSSE standard rather than Privometry's snake_case convention so that standard DSSE and Sigstore tooling can verify Privometry artifacts. Each signature is Ed25519 over PAE(payloadType, payload bytes).

payloadType.description: Media type of the payload, for example application/vnd.privometry.bundle+json.

payload.description: Standard base64 of the exact payload bytes that were signed.
